# Transcription fixtures

`day1_consultation01.json` is the reference transcript of PriMock57 consultation day1_consultation01, with doctor and patient utterances and their times, converted from the dataset's TextGrid annotations. `asr_wer_test.cpp` scores the transcriber against it. The matching recording is `demo/day1_consultation01_mixed.wav`, one of the example recordings.

PriMock57 is by Babylon Health (Papadopoulos Korfiatis et al., 2022) and is licensed under CC BY 4.0: https://github.com/babylonhealth/primock57
